scope.contract: Original immutable I-005 and s3 insert/move/copy-paste rows. This slice opens only collision mode=insert for PasteClips and MoveClips on existing same-kind tracks in the same project. Reject and overwrite remain distinct. Ripple-delete, ripple-trim, ripple-close of a move source, new-track creation, cross-project bake and the OS clipboard are not implemented.
scope.temporalSemantics: Insert opens one hole whose length L is the package span (earliest start to latest end), not a per-member punch. Ripple tracks are the targets union syncLock media tracks, or an explicit rippleTrackIds list that cannot drop targets or include caption tracks. Items that strictly span at are split (original id on the left, new id on the right, sources and opacity curves remapped); later items start+=L. Non-target ripple tracks receive a gap of length L. Sequence duration grows by L. A move vacates its source as a gap and does not close it.
scope.preserved: Link closure is complete (includeLinks=true). Source time, cropped opacity curves, static effects, proxy/asset version refs and audio offsets are preserved. Split AV link pairs get a rebuilt right-hand group. Absolute captions that would have to move or split refuse CAPTION_SYNC_EDIT_NOT_IMPLEMENTED; caption cue-follow/anchor policy is not opened. Locked target tracks raise FIELD_LOCKED; a locked syncLock non-target that would move raises SYNC_LOCKED. Transitions at the insert cut are deleted; a later dissolve is remapped onto the right remnant and shifted; a fully-moved pair keeps and shifts its cut.
scope.history: Each insert paste or move is one existing persistent command with snapshot undo/redo, save/reopen, archive fork and AAC MP4 export. Pointer drag, checkbox multi-move, numeric snap preview and paste honor the shared workbench collision mode (default reject). No new persistence schema or fingerprint side branch.
scope.ui: Workbench Collision mode adds Insert (key collision-mode-insert) beside reject and overwrite. Ripple-delete/trim remain documented as closed. UI tests jump foundation-scroll and do not drag through the pointer timeline.
